description: Reads the pitch at one jack and raises a separate gate for each note name, so any octave of the same note lights the same output

inputs.text: The pitch to be sorted, 1V per octave with 0V read as C; every channel patched here is sorted on its own
Lets a note through only while its own channel here reads 1V or more; with a single channel at 1V or more, or with nothing patched, every note is let through

outputs.text: Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing B in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing A# in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing A in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing G# in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing G in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing F# in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing F in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing E in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing D# in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing D in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing C# in any octave, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while some channel of the pitch input is playing C in any octave, and 0V otherwise

notes: the pitch is rounded to the nearest semitone before it is sorted, so a voltage a quarter-tone either side of a note raises that note's output
a lamp at full brightness means the note is being let through and a dim lamp means the note is there but its gate is holding it back

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads every note let through; a negative voltage does nothing here.
